notes.subject: חלכאים
notes.rationale: Wok חלכא i kamap long Tanakh hia tasol (plenty-fom) — man i tambu tru, ol man poroman.

notes.subject: בעצומיו
notes.rationale: Tupela ridin: 'strongpela paw/han bilong en' (laion) o 'ol man strong bilong en' (ol man); konteks bilong laion i sanapim 'strongpela han'.

translation: Em i pairap daun, em i bel daun, na ol man poroman i pundaun aninit long strongpela han bilong en.

tokens.gloss: aninit long strongpela han bilong en
